name: Anita George
role: Computer Science Undergraduate · Full-Stack Developer · UI/UX Enthusiast
university: Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam (IIIT Kottayam)
blurb: Anita George is a Computer Science Engineering undergraduate at IIIT Kottayam (2024–2028, GPA 9.03/10). She works across the full stack — from algorithmic backends and graph-theoretic optimization to accessibility-focused UI/UX. Her projects sit at the intersection of scalable systems, humane technology, and emotionally aware design, with a particular interest in safety, accessibility, and adaptive interfaces.
philosophy: Anita's work consistently combines scalable systems, accessibility-focused thinking, and strong interface design sensibilities.
Several of her projects explore how technology can reduce harm, improve accessibility, or create calmer, more honest user experiences.
She is interested in both backend systems (algorithms, APIs, optimization) and frontend systems (component architecture, interaction design, accessibility).
Graph theory and optimization appear repeatedly across her work — both as engineering tools and as design metaphors.
